basic_details.job_title: WCD Korba Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Security Guard / Night Guard Posts
basic_details.short_information: Women and Child Development, District Korba (WCD Korba) has notified 1 vacancy for the Security Guard / Night Guard post on a contract basis under advertisement number 4900/mabavi/stha./2026-27. Eligible female candidates must submit their offline application by speed post or registered post to the Office of District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Korba, Chhattisgarh, on or before 30 October 2026, starting from 21 October 2026. content_sections.heading: WCD Korba Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Women and Child Development, District Korba (WCD Korba)
Passed 8th standard from a recognized board with 2 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent via speed post or registered post to the following address: Office of District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Korba, Chhattisgarh Applicants must ensure the application reaches the office within the prescribed timeline. Late applications will not be accepted. The envelope containing the application form must clearly mention the name of the post for which the application is submitted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Passed 8th standard from a recognized board. At least 2 years of experience working as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district or state level. Preference will be given to retired military or paramilitary personnel. The candidate must be a minimum of 21 years old and not more than 35 years old as of 01 January 2026. Upper age relaxations are applicable as per Chhattisgarh government general administration department norms, up to a maximum age limit of 45 years including all relaxations. All posts are exclusively for female candidates. The candidate must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh, supported by a domicile certificate issued by a competent authority. A permanent caste certificate issued by a competent authority must be attached for reserved category candidates.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of mark sheets and certificates of 8th standard and other educational qualifications. Proof of date of birth (Birth certificate or 8th/10th mark sheet). Chhattisgarh domicile certificate. Permanent caste certificate for reserved category applicants. Work experience certificate for at least 2 years issued and attested by the competent authority of the organization. Original passport-size photograph with candidate's signature pasted on the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on merit prepared through an academic percentage weightage system, experience weightage, and a skill test. Academic Weightage: Maximum 60 marks awarded based on the percentage obtained in the minimum required educational qualification. Experience Weightage: Maximum 10 marks awarded, calculated at 02 marks for each additional year of experience beyond the minimum required experience. Bonus Marks: Up to 10 bonus marks awarded at 02 marks per year for work experience in the women's helpline or Sakhi One Stop Center. Skill Test: 20 marks allocated for a skill test, which includes testing knowledge of the local language and dialect. The total merit is calculated out of 80 marks, and candidates are called for skill tests or interviews in a ratio of 1:5 or 1:10 per post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under WCD Korba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy is announced for the Security Guard / Night Guard post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form by speed post or registered post is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Security Guard post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 8th standard from a recognized board along with at least 2 years of experience working as security personnel.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 35 years of age as of 01 January 2026, with relaxations up to 45 years as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Security Guard position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 11,360/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for WCD Korba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must download the application form from the notification, fill it out, attach necessary self-attested documents, and send it via speed post or registered post to the Office of District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Korba.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are native residents of Chhattisgarh and meet the educational and experience criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q9. Is this appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contractual basis for an initial period of up to 2 years, subject to performance and scheme continuation.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared using academic percentage, work experience, bonus marks, and a skill test involving local language proficiency.
